name: Alavi 2026 AlphaGenome splicing discrepancy: awaiting a corrected preprint
description: Where the AlphaGenome-against-Borzoi discrepancy on Alavi's 65-gene splicing set stands: a 1-base coordinate offset was found in the published AlphaGenome scripts, reported upstream, and accepted by the author, who is rerunning the analysis.

attributes.rationale: Both AlphaGenome scripts subtract 1 from a 1-based variant coordinate before calling AlphaGenome's 1-based Variant API, so every variant was scored one base from its real position. The author accepted this and reports that rerunning with the variant set to pos_1based substantially improved accuracy, so the stored sensitivity and specificity do not describe the intended variants.
attributes.upstream_response: On 2026-10-20 the author labelled the issue a bug and replied that running the splice scorer with the variant set to pos_1based substantially improved accuracy, promising updated scripts in calendar week 44 and a revised manuscript with updated data in early November 2026.
attributes.awaiting: The author's corrected scripts and the revised preprint with rerun results.

review.reviewer_note: Recorded by a Claude agent from the upstream issue and its comment; no human review claimed.
review.method_note: Retrieved the upstream issue and its comments through the GitHub API and read the author's reply; the state and dates are taken from those bytes.
review.note: Records where the discrepancy stands, not a correction to any result. The affected results keep their reported values until the authors publish the rerun.
